title: Provider runner handoff outbox import pipeline smoke
objective: 新增严格本地 smoke：用临时后端创建 scheduler run，手动为两个 queued provider-review 调度项准备 executor request、授权并导出 handoff，组装 ProviderAdapterRunnerHandoffOutbox v0.1，调用本地 outbox consumer 生成 receipt/envelope，再显式导回临时后端 ledger，并验证 prefetch-cache 从导入前 0 个 review-only envelope 变为导入后 2 个，同时 runtime activation 仍为 0。
acceptance_commands: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; report=json.loads(Path('/tmp/provider_runner_handoff_outbox_import_pipeline_report.v0.1.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')); summary=report['summary']; safety=report['safety_summary']; assert report['status']=='passed'; assert summary['runner_handoff_count']==2; assert summary['consumer_executed_count']==2; assert summary['imported_count']==2; assert summary['pre_import_review_only_envelope_ready_count']==0; assert summary['prefetch_review_only_envelope_ready_count']==2; assert summary['activation_allowed_count']==0; assert safety['external_provider_call_count']==0; assert safety['consumer_reads_env_count']==0; assert safety['staging_count']==0; assert safety['promotion_count']==0; assert safety['queue_complete_count']==0; assert safety['world_mutation_count']==0; assert safety['runtime_activation_allowed_count']==0"
notes: 本 smoke 使用临时 SQLite 与本地 uvicorn；不读取 .env，不调用 live provider。
脚本先断言 prefetch-cache 导入前没有 review-only envelope，再断言导入后出现 2 个 envelope，避免把 background tick 已生成的 ledger 当作导入因果证据。
outbox consumer 本身仍不导入后端；导入动作只由本 smoke 对临时后端显式执行。
该任务不提交生成报告到仓库，验收报告写入 /tmp。
